title: Children gain psychic powers after seeing Geller on TV
summary: Greg tells of Children gain psychic powers after seeing Geller on TV, about early–mid 1970s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: these kids would see um Geller on TV and all of a sudden like that would uh cause them to just spontaneously like do something psychic.

plain: A researcher named Greg says that in the early 1970s, newspaper articles reported a strange effect from Uri Geller, a performer who claimed to bend spoons with his mind and who was promoted by a researcher named Andrija Puharich. According to Greg, children in the United States, Britain and China would watch Geller on television and then suddenly start doing psychic things themselves, as if his appearance switched something on in them.
